content.title: About
content.content: Frescavena is a plant‑based food product designed to support a healthy lifestyle. It has a mild flavor, light texture, and can be used in a variety of dishes.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Frescavena is made from selected whole grains and legumes.
The product is gluten‑free and suitable for people with gluten intolerance.
It contains natural flavorings and minimal artificial additives.
Frescavena has a low glycemic index, making it suitable for blood‑sugar control.
Packaging is made from recyclable materials.

items.title: Rich in plant protein
items.content: Provides high‑quality plant protein that helps maintain muscle mass.

items.title: Source of fiber
items.content: Fiber supports digestion and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Most of the fat is polyunsaturated, beneficial for cardiovascular health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Contains B1, B2, B6 vitamins that are involved in energy metabolism.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: Includes magnesium, iron, and zinc, important for nervous and immune systems.

items.title: Allergy to plant ingredients
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to the product’s components.

items.title: High fiber content
items.content: Excessive consumption may cause gastrointestinal discomfort.

items.title: Oxalate content
items.content: The product contains a small amount of oxalates, which should be considered by people prone to kidney stones.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Frescavena can be enjoyed as a snack, added to smoothies, porridge, yogurt, salads, or used in baking. It can also be soaked beforehand for a softer texture.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store Frescavena in a sealed container in a cool, dry, dark place. For long‑term storage, keep it in the refrigerator. Discard if the smell or taste changes.
